Title: Equality (mathematics)
Description: Basic notion of sameness in mathematics
Paragraph: In mathematics, equality is a relationship between two quantities or expressions, stating that they have the same value, or represent the same mathematical object. Equality between A and B is denoted with an equals sign as A = B, and read "A equals B". A written expression of equality is called an equation or identity depending on the context. Two objects that are not equal are said to be distinct.
